newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up marginally on overseas buying.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up marginally on overseas buying.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia closed one cent higher at 14.55 ringgit ($5.88) a kg on foreign demand, traders said.
A lower close in London overnight was ignored.

"The market was steady because of some foreign demand," a trader said. Turnover was 120 tonnes, against 118 tonnes on Tuesday, with buying mainly from Europe. Some light Malaysian interest was also seen.
The local price differential to London was $20 a tonne premium after a discount of $20 previously.
